title: Cline
intro: Cline, headless over `cline --json`, on an OpenAI-compatible provider. Headless Cline ignores base-URL variables, so the folder writes `$HOME/.cline/data/settings/providers.json` with the gateway URL and the session token as the key.
notes: `CLINE_SESSION_BACKEND_MODE=local` keeps it from starting a detached hub daemon.
The key written to `providers.json` is the session token, worthless outside the run; the real key never leaves the gateway.
Each turn starts a fresh conversation in the same workspace, so the recall check passes by looking at the files, not by remembering; give a later turn the context it needs in the prompt.
caveat: Headless Cline cannot resume a session (that needs its ACP mode); it answers recall by looking at the workspace, not by remembering.
